# Integrations and Setup

Source: https://docs.linkzly.com/docs/sdk-integrations-setup

This page is for the step after install and events: start from the Linkzly product you use, then find what it needs from the console, from your app project and from the SDK. Each capability below has the same four parts, in the same order: what it does, what to set up in the console, what to set up in your app project, and the SDK calls. It applies to all four mobile SDKs, and every code sample is shown in Swift, Kotlin, TypeScript and Dart wherever the platform has the capability.

Install and configure the SDK first. The install lines for each platform are in [Mobile SDKs](https://docs.linkzly.com/docs/sdks#mobile-sdks), and the full steps are in the Installation section of your platform page: [iOS](https://docs.linkzly.com/docs/sdk-ios#installation), [Android](../sdk/installation.md), [React Native](https://docs.linkzly.com/docs/sdk-react-native#installation) or [Flutter](https://docs.linkzly.com/docs/sdk-flutter#installation). Events are on [Tracking Events](../events/overview.md) and purchases are on [Tracking Purchases](../purchases/overview.md).

This page routes you to the detail; it does not repeat it. The console walkthroughs stay on the product pages, and the full API stays on the platform pages. Console screen names on this page are the names the console shows today. Some product pages still use older names for the same screens, such as "Apps", "Deeplink" or "Google Play URL"; where the two differ, follow this page.
